SUB.: 
TRANSCRIPT OF EARNINGS CALL OF AXIS BANK LIMITED (“BANK”) – FOR THE QUARTER ENDED 
SEPTEMBER 30, 2026 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations, the transcript of earnings call held on                    
October 17, 2026, on the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results of the Bank for 
the quarter ended September 30, 2026, has been made available on the website of the Bank at: 
 
https://www.axis.bank.in/docs/default-source/shareholders/financial-results-and-other-
information/call-transcript/2026-2027/q2fy27-earnings-call.pdf 
 
This is for your information and records.  
 
Thanking You.  
 
With warm regards, 
 
For Axis Bank Limited
